product_metadata.title: Shazo Airtight Food Storage Containers 7 Piece Set, Pantry Organizer BPA Free Plastic Flour, Pasta Containers with Easy Lock Lids for Kitchen Pantry Organization and Storage Includes Labels & Marker
features: Versatile Storage Solution : The set includes 1 tall 1.9L, 2 medium 1.3L, 2 small 0.8L, and 2 mini containers 0.5L, optimizing your storage space. Our complete range of containers is perfect for storing various food items like cereal, pasta, rice, and grains.
Airtight Secure Seal : Our containers feature a secure lid locking system, keeping contents dry and fresh. Perfect for storing ingredients and bulk foods.
BPA-Free Protection : Our containers are crafted from premium BPA-free plastic, ensuring durability and safeguarding your well-being in a fresh and organized kitchen.
Confusion-Free Organization: Our 24 reusable labels ensure you never mix up ingredients again. Easily switch contents whenever needed for hassle-free kitchen organization.
Hassle-Free Cleaning: Remove the silicone piece, hand wash, and dry lids thoroughly. Re-wrap the silicone, and you're good to go. Easy and convenient!
